'''Charles Hickey''' (also known as '''Charlie''' and '''Charley'''; GEMP handle '''Teacher''')<ref name="retro-gempc-86781">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86781 Player List for 2026 Retro GEMPC], forum.starwarsccg.org (14 June 2026).
